text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's already this late.
I have to go train—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: This shop has sooo many gorgeous clothes on display!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Every single one fits Falco's ideals...
It's a perfect match for that 'cute Umadol vibe'☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A long skirt with plenty of ruffles,
an oversized knit sweater dress...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This reversible blouse over here
looks like it'd be useful for so many outfits...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So nice, so nice~!
It's making my heart skip a beat~!

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!
Please feel free to try anything on~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you so much☆
Which one should I start with~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, Smart Falcon completely
forgot about training."
